Title: ConnectionInfo - LLM Connection Metadata
Summary: Record representing metadata about an LLM connection including model, provider, and capability flags.
Content:
## ConnectionInfo

**Namespace**: `Cyrena.Models`
**Assembly**: `Cyrena.Core`

### Purpose
Record representing metadata about an LLM connection. Returned by `IConnectionProvider.ListConnectionsAsync()` and `IConnectionProvider.AttachAsync()`.

### Record Definition
```csharp
public record ConnectionInfo(
    string Id, 
    string Name, 
    string Source, 
    string ModelId, 
    IConnectionProvider Provider, 
    bool SupportImages, 
    bool SupportFiles
);
```

### Properties
| Property | Type | Description |
|----------|------|-------------|
| `Id` | `string` | Unique connection identifier |
| `Name` | `string` | Display name for UI |
| `Source` | `string` | Provider source identifier (e.g., "Ollama", "OpenAI") |
| `ModelId` | `string` | Model identifier (e.g., "llama3.1", "gpt-4") |
| `Provider` | `IConnectionProvider` | The provider that created this connection |
| `SupportImages` | `bool` | Whether the connection supports image input |
| `SupportFiles` | `bool` | Whether the connection supports file attachments |

### Usage
```csharp
var connections = await connectionProvider.ListConnectionsAsync();
foreach (var conn in connections)
{
    Console.WriteLine($"{conn.Name} ({conn.ModelId}) - Images: {conn.SupportImages}");
}
```

### Related
- `IConnectionProvider` - Creates ConnectionInfo instances
- `IConnection` - The actual connection implementation
- `ChatConfiguration` - Stores the selected ConnectionId
